summary: John's 11th-great-grandmother, wife of Capt. Thomas Topping.
bio: Probably baptized at Langley Marish (a chapelry of Wraysbury), Bucks., c. Jul 1611. Her father Ambrose bought the manor of Remingham and Cow in Wraysbury in 1611 and sold it for £500 in 1613. Tree gives 1610–1665; Thomas Topping married three times, so whether she was Elnathan's mother rests on dates.
openQuestions: Was she the mother of Elnathan (b. 1640), given Thomas's three marriages?
